documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: KSH International reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings, highlighting robust volume growth, capacity expansion at Supa, and a significant surge in exports and EBITDA per ton. Management noted that Phase-2 of the Supa expansion is largely complete and announced a new Phase-3 expansion to increase total installed capacity to 72,200 metric tons by Q1 FY29. The company also registered improvements in working capital efficiency, reducing outstanding debt and delivering positive operating cash flow during H1 FY27. Looking ahead, management views a 26% volume growth rate as sustainable for the year and projects a long-term EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 85,000 post Phase-3 expansion.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the 26% volume growth for this year continues to be sustainable.
guidance.quote: Firstly, we believe that 26% volume growth for this year continues to be sustainable and will benefit from having our expanded capacity available in H2.

guidance.claim: Management believes that post Phase-3 expansion, a long-term EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 85,000 per ton should be sustainable.
guidance.quote: Secondly, looking at our overall long-term portfolio and capacity mix and the additional traction with exports and improving operating leverage, we believe post Phase-3 expansion, a long-term EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 85,000 per ton should be sustainable.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company is expecting a 25% to 26% increase in quantities over the last year.
guidance.quote: If you take that into account, our second half is expected to be better than the first half.

guidance.claim: Management believes the company should be able to sustain the trailing 12-month volume growth rate of 26% for the full year FY27.
guidance.quote: The higher phase one capacity will be available for the full year FY27 as opposed to only for a part of FY26, and therefore, we feel that we should be able to sustain this rate of volume growth for the full year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they see sustained growth and investments across power generation, transmission, and related equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: We see sustained growth and investments across power generation, transmission and related equipment driven by grid infrastructure development, renewable energy integration, electrification and growth, electricity requirements from industrial and digital infrastructure.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that specialized magnet winding wires revenue grew 87% year-over-year during Q2, driven largely by exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Specialized Magnet Winding Wires revenue overall grew at 87% year-over-year during Q2, with much of that growth driven by exports.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported that standard wire growth was 119% in Q2 compared to a year ago.
demand_outlook.quote: Standard wire growth was 119% in Q2 compared to a year ago and outpaced specialized magnet winding wire growth, but important to note that the growth is of a much smaller base than specialized wires.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that export revenue grew 108% year-over-year and was 44% higher than the previous quarter in Q2.
demand_outlook.quote: Export revenue in Q2 grew 108% year-over-year and 44% higher than last quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that a few transformer OEM customers in active capacity expansion mode have delayed picking up orders by a few weeks.
demand_outlook.quote: There is one short-term industry dynamic we have observed and I feel it's worth calling out, which is that we have seen a few of the transformer OEM customers who are in active capacity expansion mode, delay picking up their orders by a few weeks.

demand_outlook.claim: The T&D sector is in a structural long-term cycle driven by renewable energy, grid modernization, urbanization, and growing power demand for AI data centers.
demand_outlook.quote: The T&D sector, as you know it, is in a structural long-term cycle driven by renewable energy, grid modernization, urbanization, and growing power demand for AI data centers in India as well as globally.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved a new Phase-3 expansion to add specialized magnet winding wires manufacturing capacity, increasing total installed capacity to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved a new Phase-3 expansion to add specialized Magnet Winding Wires manufacturing capacity, and which is expected to increase the company's total installed capacity to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029.

capex_expansion.claim: The company intends to spend up to Rs. 1,850 million or Rs. 185 crores to finance the Phase-3 expansion, which includes purchasing an additional 10 acres of land in Supa.
capex_expansion.quote: The company intends to spend up to Rs. 1,850 million or Rs. 185 crores to finance this expansion, which also includes he purchase of an additional 10 acres of land in Supa and it will be funded with a combination of internal accruals and long-term debt.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed 96% of its proposed Supa expansion six months ahead of schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Meanwhile, we also completed 96% of our proposed Supa expansion six-months ahead of schedule, giving us 57,845 MT of available capacity heading into the second half of the year.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the Supa expansion remains on track for FY27 completion, with the next wave of capacity expected in Q2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our Supa expansion continues to remain on track for FY27 completion with the next wave of capacity expected to be added in Q2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The board authorized management to evaluate acquiring an additional 10 acres of land within Supa MIDC for long-term expansion requirements.
capex_expansion.quote: our board last night authorized management to evaluate acquiring an additional 10 acres of land within Supa MIDC for its long-term expansion requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcast backward integration facility in Chakan was commissioned with a capacity of 5,000 metric tons to recycle internal copper scrap.
capex_expansion.quote: Last week, we completed yet another one of our IPO objectives on time by commissioning our upcast backward integration facility in Chakan. This facility will have a capacity of 5,000 metric tons and be used to recycle our own copper scrap, which in turn should provide some modest operating efficiency and further strengthen our sustainability efforts.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported Q2 FY '27 EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 101,400 per metric ton.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2 FY '27, we reported EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 101,400 per metric ton up from roughly Rs. 93,000 per metric ton in Q1 and Rs. 65,500 per metric ton a year ago.

margins_costs.claim: Metal prices are fully passed through in the revenue model.
Management expects some fixed costs to increase as capacity utilization is ramped up in the Supa plant.
margins_costs.quote: We also want to highlight that we expect some fixed costs to increase as we ramp up capacity utilization going forward in the Supa plant.

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity as on September 30, 2026, was 57,845 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Our installed capacity as on September 30th, 2026 was 57,845 metric tons, which includes 96% of the total capacity expansion planned at Supa.

orders_capacity.claim: Consolidated utilization rates increased to 76% in Q2 of FY '27 versus 73% in Q1.
orders_capacity.quote: The third point being an increase in consolidated utilization rates to 76% in Q2 of FY '27 versus 73% in Q1 of FY '27 based on available capacity for the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity at June 30, 2026, was 43,445 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Our installed capacity at June 30th, 2026 was 43,445 metric tons and once phase two of our Super expansion is complete by the end of this year, this financial year, we would have an installed capacity of roughly 59,000 metric tons, making us the second largest winding wire manufacturer in India.

orders_capacity.claim: The company entered into a five-year supply framework agreement with Hitachi Energy Global.
orders_capacity.quote: We are very pleased to announce that we have entered into a five-year supply framework agreement with Hitachi Energy Global to supply winding wires to their Indian plants as well as their some of their global plants.

capital_allocation.claim: Management reported generating approximately Rs. 43 crores of positive operating cash flow during H1 FY '27.
capital_allocation.quote: As a result of these efforts, we were able to deliver roughly Rs. 43 crores of positive operating cash flow during H1 of FY '27, while also reducing outstanding debt by approximately Rs. 140 crores by September 30th of 2026 from Q1 of FY '27.

capital_allocation.claim: Total outstanding debt was reduced to Rs. 341 crores down from Rs. 481 crores in Q1 FY '27.
capital_allocation.quote: This also led to a reduction in total outstanding debt to Rs. 341 crores down from Rs. 481 crores in Q1 FY '27.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital efficiency contributed to positive operating cash flow during H1 FY2027 and a reduction in outstanding debt during the second quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Together with operating growth, our focus on working capital efficiency contributed to positive operating cash flow during H1 FY2027, and a reduction in outstanding debt during the second quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Average working capital days improved to 60 days during Q1 compared to 71 days a year ago.
capital_allocation.quote: resulting in an average working capital days of 60 days during the quarter compared to 71 days a year ago.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that due to disturbances in the Middle East, transit times have increased significantly.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes. So, as far as the business in Middle East is concerned, we have not seen a significant drop in the business from Middle East, though, because of the disturbance, the transit times have increased significantly as compared to earlier times.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an objective to return exports to its historical average of around 40% of total revenue over the next few years.
management_commitments.quote: We said that our objective over the next few years is to return exports to its historical average of around 40% of total revenue.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that Phase-3 capacity expansion is expected to increase total installed capacity to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved a new Phase-3 expansion to add specialized Magnet Winding Wires manufacturing capacity, and which is expected to increase the company's total installed capacity to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029.

management_commitments.claim: The board approved a Phase 3 expansion at Supa for specialized magnet winding wires that would result in total capacity increasing to 72,200 MTs by Q1 FY2029.
management_commitments.quote: Lastly, our Board has approved a Phase 3 expansion at Supa for Specialized Magnet Winding Wires that would result in total capacity increasing to 72,200 MTs by Q1 FY2029, while also improving the long-term product mix of the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 2 of the Supa capacity expansion will be completed by March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Number one being, we are on track to complete the remaining phase two capacity by March 2027 with the next wave of addition expected during Q2.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
